source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY CT / Non-specific Lower Extremity Pain (1,2)
source_quote: Lower extremity pain with no specific joint identified with MRI contraindicated or cannot be performed AND with prior X-ray

criteria.description: Lower extremity pain without specific localized joint involvement
Prior plain radiographs (X-ray) completed of the symptomatic region
MRI is medically contraindicated or cannot be performed

required_documentation: Plain radiograph report and clinical documentation detailing MRI contraindication (e.g. non-MRI conditional pacemaker, foreign body)
review_notes: Lower extremity CT indication requiring prior X-ray and MRI contraindication.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY ANGIOGRAPHY (CTA) / Lower Extremity Peripheral Vascular Disease
source_quote: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY ANGIOGRAPHY (CTA)

criteria.description: Known or clinically suspected lower extremity peripheral arterial disease undergoing revascularization planning

required_documentation: Vascular surgery evaluation detailing non-invasive vascular testing (ABI/PVR) and surgical or endovascular revascularization plan
review_notes: Lower extremity CTA for revascularization and endovascular intervention planning.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY MAGNETIC RESONANCE ANGIOGRAPHY (MRA) / Peripheral Arterial Disease
source_quote: For known or suspected atherosclerotic peripheral arterial disease when any ONE of the following non-invasive studies are abnormal or indeterminate

criteria.description: Known or suspected atherosclerotic peripheral arterial disease of the lower extremities
Prior non-invasive vascular study (ankle-brachial index, segmental pressures, or pulse volume recording) is abnormal or indeterminate

required_documentation: Vascular lab report showing abnormal ABI (< 0.9) or pulse volume recordings
review_notes: Diagnostic prerequisite non-invasive vascular testing prior to lower extremity MRA.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY MRI / Joint Specific Pain or Suspected Joint Specific Injury
source_quote: Joint Specific Pain or Suspected Joint Specific Injury
clinical_service_or_procedure: Lower Extremity MRI (Knee, Hip, Ankle, Foot)

criteria.description: Evaluation of joint-specific pain, mechanical locking, instability, or suspected internal derangement (ligament/meniscal tear)

required_documentation: Physical examination documenting joint effusion, mechanical locking, McMurray, Lachman, or joint line tenderness and initial X-ray report
review_notes: Standard lower extremity joint MRI for internal derangement.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LUMBAR SPINE CT / Evaluation of Neurologic Deficits (1)

criteria.description: Evaluation of acute lumbar trauma, surgical fusion integrity/pseudoarthrosis, or lumbar pain when MRI is contraindicated

required_documentation: Clinical notes documenting spinal trauma, hardware evaluation, or contraindication to lumbar MRI
review_notes: Lumbar spine CT for bony architecture and fusion assessment.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LUMBAR SPINE MRI / Evaluation of Neurologic Deficits (1)

criteria.description: Evaluation of low back pain with lumbosacral radiculopathy or radiating leg pain
Completion of at least 6 weeks of conservative care within the prior 6 months without meaningful improvement

required_documentation: Physical therapy records or clinical follow-up notes documenting 6 weeks of conservative treatment
review_notes: Conservative care prerequisite trial for lumbar radiculopathy.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LUMBAR SPINE MRI / Evaluation of Neurologic Deficits / Cauda Equina Syndrome
source_quote: defined symptoms (see Cauda Equina Syndrome section)

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of acute cauda equina syndrome with saddle anesthesia, progressive bilateral motor weakness, or bowel/bladder sphincter dysfunction

required_documentation: Urgent neurological or emergency evaluation documenting saddle sensory loss or acute sphincter incontinence
review_notes: Emergency cauda equina syndrome pathway bypassing conservative care trial.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN MR ELASTOGRAPHY / Evaluation of Hepatic Fibrosis (1–3)

criteria.description: Evaluation of hepatic fibrosis in patient with chronic liver disease (e.g. MASLD/MASH, viral hepatitis)
Calculated Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) index score is greater than or equal to 2.67

required_documentation: Laboratory data calculating FIB-4 index score (age, AST, ALT, platelets) or documentation of inconclusive ultrasound elastography
review_notes: Non-invasive quantitative staging of advanced hepatic fibrosis.
